scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Castes Students- Gujarat
other_conditions: The student must belong to the Scheduled Caste category of Gujarat.
The student must have passed Matriculation, Higher Secondary or any higher examination of a recognized University or Board of Secondary Education.
Candidates who, after passing one stage of education, enroll in the same stage in a different subject (e.g., Intermediate Science after Intermediate Arts) are not eligible.
Students studying through correspondence/online courses are eligible for the scholarship but not for the academic allowance.
A scholarship holder cannot hold any other scholarship or stipend simultaneously.
Seats filled through arbitrary, non‑transparent processes such as management or NRI quota are not eligible.
Attendance of at least 75 % in each academic year is required for continuation of the award.
If a student misses an exam due to illness, renewal is possible upon submission of a medical certificate.
benefits_summary: Provides yearly academic allowance ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹13,500 for hostellers and ₹2,500 to ₹7,000 for day scholars, with an additional 10 % allowance for disabled (Divyang) students.
